review.verdict: The two-panel idea reads generically (robot new hire / robot picking a rich target) but drops the brief's specific classroom-emptying metaphor (no desks, only one student) and the magnifying glass floats disconnected from the hooded robot's hand, so it falls just short of publish-ready.
revisionNotes: Add a desk/chair raw shape under the empty seat and 1-2 more small human students at the left-third so the 'empty desk now filled by a robot' beat actually reads — right now the student and robot just stand on open ground with no classroom cue.

Attach the magnifier to the hooded robot's hand: its arms are raised/empty and the magnifying glass floats disconnected to the right, so the 'holding a magnifying glass over the cards' action doesn't land — move the magnifier offset to overlap the raised hand or switch arms prop to a holding pose.
Stamp a visible '$' on all three cards (one currently shows '!' and one is blank) so 'profile cards each marked with a dollar sign' reads consistently.
Both panels have the top half as flat empty color; raise the horizon/ground or scale the figure groups up slightly to fill the square better and strengthen the focal point.
Nudge the 'student' anchor right from x:0.14 to ~x:0.18; lint already flags it clipping the left safe-area edge.
The vertical-divider split-panel layout was used twice in the recent set; consider a softer separator (desk edge, doorway) instead of a hard dividing line for more novelty.
